# Image resize fixtures

The source PNGs encode RGB coordinate ramps, with blue fixed at 255. `downsample-source.png` is 512x256; `upsample-source.png` is 64x64. The expected images were independently generated by Pillow bicubic resize to 352x160 and 256x256 respectively. Official Transformers' Qwen image processor using Torchvision's antialiased bicubic uint8 resize produced identical pixels for these fixtures. They test fixed-point resampling separately from model weights; no model download or GPU is required.
